  "body": "Dear Chinedu,

I wanted to give you an update on your claim for the burst supply line in your basement at 2620 Central Park Ave.

Drying is now complete and the moisture readings are back to normal. As confirmed earlier, sudden and accidental water discharge is covered under your homeowners policy ANT-HO-204585, and your $2,500 deductible applies. We have already paid you an advance of $5,000 for emergency drying and immediate needs.

We have now received the mitigation invoice from Lakeshore Restoration and the rebuild estimate from Northshore Renovation. We are reviewing both this week, and we expect to approve the rebuild estimate shortly so repairs to your flooring, drywall and furnace can get started. Your stored belongings are also part of the claim.

I will be in touch once the review is done. In the meantime, please let me know if you have any questions.

Kind regards,

Demo User
Antsurance",
